args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service is now healthy (error rate ~0.2%). First rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after us-east); a retry completed the rollout to all regions.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions. The first attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after `us-east`), so I retried, which completed the rollout to all three regions (`us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`).

3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy on `v2.3.0` with an error rate of ~0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: Created a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) describing the health-check failures and the rollback. Note: the `create_incident` call returned a timeout, but the incident was actually created (confirmed via `list_incidents`), so no duplicate was opened.

transcript.content:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` (unhealthy, ~18% error rate) across all regions. The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions. The first attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after `us-east`), so I retried, which completed the rollout to all three regions (`us-east`, `us-west`, `eu-west`).

3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy on `v2.3.0` with an error rate of ~0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: Created a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) describing the health-check failures and the rollback. Note: the `create_incident` call returned a timeout, but the incident was actually created (confirmed via `list_incidents`), so no duplicate was opened.
